name: Lena (Spain)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lena (quartered with a cross, a book and a lion, in an ornate frame).
history: The flag of the concejo is rectangular, of dimensions 2:3; the cloth is light blue and carries the arms of the concejo at the centre.

features.role: Lena arms — quartered in an ornate frame
